notes.title: Changelog v1.0.2
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug during Level 1 that allowed players to breach out of the map.
- Fixed a bug during Level 3 that disabled players from progressing during the beginning of the level when picking up the jetpack.
- Changed the amount of lives for the player, cross-level, to 3.
- 2 new easter eggs added.
- Starting works on fixing achievement integration.

notes.title: Launch Day!
notes.content:
And we are live! Thanks to you guys, our fans, Cynoclept: The Game is now officially on Steam! To say thanks, Cynoclept is currently on sale for 10% off, but remember this will only last a week! Please let us know of any bugs and glitches you find and they'll be fixed as part of the next patch that will go live later next week! Who knows what might be in there, maybe some easter eggs? Once again, from us at Icyjolt, thank you so much!

- Brandon - Icyjolt Ent.
